lifetime.startup: no display EC access or automatic replay
lifetime.resume: invalidate old fences; no display replay
lifetime.release: invalidate fence; do not restore persistent setting
lifetime.suspend: invalidate; gate every EC write and final acceptance
lifetime.chargeDomain: lazy and independent; display request must not create charge controller or recover charge journal

ownership.bus: existing Global Access_EC mutex per complete EC session
ownership.process: existing helper singleton and parent-bound private pipe
ownership.native: existing HardwareWriteLease and serial shortcut queue
ownership.key: neutral then one rising edge; configured mapping and shortcut recording suppress default
